name: @ui8kit/codegen
description: ui8kit codegen 2.0 (xgen): spec-driven generation of one typed UI contract into eight runtimes (Svelte 5, React 19, Vue 3, SolidJS, Go templ, Twig, Jinja2, Latte) with identical DOM and ARIA, plus a shared app package and one host app per TypeScript runtime. Bun workspaces.

scripts.build:hosts: bun run --cwd apps/host-svelte build && bun run --cwd apps/host-react build && bun run --cwd apps/host-vue build && bun run --cwd apps/host-solid build
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:xgen && bun run --filter "@ui8kit/svelte-ui" --filter "@ui8kit/react-ui" --filter "@ui8kit/vue-ui" --filter "@ui8kit/solid-ui" --filter "@ui8kit/app-shared" --filter "host-*" --parallel check
scripts.check:all: bun run build && bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run build:hosts && bun run test && bun run lint:px && bun run e2e
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run codex:validate && bun run typecheck:xgen && bun run test
